title: Happy Ghast Challenge
description: A challenge where if you touch the floor they die. To prevent that from happening every player starts the world with a happy ghast. (Multiplayer Friendly)
body:
In this challenge you will try to avoid the floor, or it could cost your life! Try managing a world moving with happy ghasts or any other methods you can come up with. Floating bases? Happy Ghasts and chestboats connected by leashes? Whatever you can think of. **You can also play it with friends!**

There is not an actual end to the challenge but you could give yourself the goal of killing the ender dragon, or like any other world you might play, the possibilities are endless.

There are a few weird behaviours in the pack to make the challenge possible. This could seem quirky so these are some brief explanations of them, so you understand them. There are also tips in-game reminding them, and you can watch this video [Youtube Showcase](https://youtu.be/WCTTGe-FXxI)
- Place a crafting table in the air by shift-right clicking while holding it
- Return to the overworld from the nether through the same portal you used to come in, otherwise you might get stuck in the portal in the overworld (Happy Ghasts are too big for generated portals)
- Exit the end for the first time by walking into it, after that you can exit while riding the happy ghast

Thanks for trying the datapack!
